command: const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const files=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(process.env).filter(([key])=>key.startsWith('CHARGEOS_SEED_')).map(([key,value])=>[key.slice(14),value]));for(const [name,value] of Object.entries(files)){if(!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/.test(name)||!value)throw new Error('Invalid bootstrap file');const target=path.join('/data',name);try{const fd=fs.openSync(target,fs.constants.O_CREAT|fs.constants.O_EXCL|fs.constants.O_WRONLY|fs.constants.O_NOFOLLOW,0o444);try{fs.writeFileSync(fd,value);fs.fsyncSync(fd)}finally{fs.closeSync(fd)}}catch(error){if(error.code!=='EEXIST')throw new Error('Could not create bootstrap file');const fd=fs.openSync(target,fs.constants.O_RDONLY|fs.constants.O_NOFOLLOW|fs.constants.O_NONBLOCK);try{const info=fs.fstatSync(fd);if(!info.isFile()||info.size>32768||(info.mode&511)!==292||fs.readFileSync(fd,'utf8')!==value)throw new Error('Existing bootstrap file differs; refusing replacement')}finally{fs.closeSync(fd)}}}console.log('Bootstrap files verified; existing values never replaced');
